subject: MAP: success metrics decision canvas + test harness for MedNexus pilot
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>
To: Anita Shah <anita@mednexus.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: MAP kickoff — proposed decision canvas + success measures

Hi Anita — great to meet on Monday. Based on our call I sketched a lightweight MAP focused on measurable outcomes and a small set of acceptance tests we can run during the 6-week pilot. The goal: make "go/no-go" decisions objective and fast so your IT and procurement teams can plan capacity and contracts.

High-level asks:
- Confirm the 3 priority flows we should validate (see sheet "Flows" in attachment).
- Agree the primary success metric (we've proposed "90th pct latency < 350ms" for sync API; please flag if latency is less critical than accuracy).
- Nominate the dev or infra point of contact for test runs and evidence collection.

I've attached: MAP_MedNexus_v1.xlsx (decision canvas + acceptance test table) and a short eval-test-harness.md describing how we'll run smoke and concordance checks.

If this looks good I propose we lock the MAP by Tue 11/16 and schedule a 30-min alignment with your IT lead to confirm data access.

Thanks — Camila
Camila Reyes | Senior Solution Executive | Redwood Inference
mobile: (415) 555-0192

From: Anita Shah <anita@mednexus.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 08:04:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff — proposed decision canvas + success measures

Camila — thanks, this is helpful. Quick clarifications from our side:
- Priority flows: Clinical intake triage, claims summarization, and clinician note augmentation — correct.
- Primary metric: For production sign-off we need both latency (interactive workflows) and clinical concordance (precision on entity extraction). Would you be able to propose a composite pass/fail rule?
- Our infra lead (Tom Reynolds) will join the alignment call; I'm looping him in on the next message.

We can review the MAP on Tue 11/16 10:00am PT. I'll send a calendar invite.

—Anita
Director of Product, MedNexus Health
From: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@mednexus.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>, Anita Shah <anita@mednexus.com>
Date: Fri, 13 Nov 2026 10:22:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff — proposed decision canvas + success measures

Camila — quick note from infra: we need explicit acceptance tests that map to evidence we can collect (examples: server-side latency histograms, token counts, end-to-end time from UI event to render). Also need to understand what logs you will expose and retention windows. Tom

From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@mednexus.com>, Anita Shah <anita@mednexus.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Nov 2026 07:45:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff — proposed decision canvas + success measures

Thanks Tom — good callouts. Attached is a short test harness doc that maps each acceptance test to the required artifact:
- Latency checks -> server-side p95/p99 histograms + client-measured 90th pct
- Concordance -> human-annotated sample (n=200) + F1 score target (>= 0.88 for entities)
- Stability -> 48-hour load soak at expected QPS with no more than 2% error rate

Proposed composite pass rule (binary): PASSES if all three conditions met: latency target, concordance target, and stability run with no critical errors. If any single condition fails, result = FAIL and a remediation sprint is required.

Draft MAP highlights (from attachment):
- Decision owners: Anita (product), Tom (infra), Camila (commercial)
- Evidence collection windows: week 2 (smoke + concordance), week 5 (soak + final metrics)
- Rollback/stop conditions: repeated data drift > 15% on entity distribution or >5% increase in refusal rate

Can Marcus and Lauren review the F1 target and proposed sample size? Marcus: is n=200 adequate for initial concordance? Lauren: any legal/procurement risk with the rollback triggers?

—Camila
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>, Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@mednexus.com>, Anita Shah <anita@mednexus.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Nov 2026 11:31:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff — proposed decision canvas + success measures

Camila — n=200 is fine for an initial sanity concordance check if the sample is stratified across the three flows. For statistical confidence to declare production readiness I'd recommend n=600 (power > 0.8) but that can be part of a post-pilot validation runway. Also: recommend we add an automated rejection-rate monitor (daily) and a named alert for sudden spikes — that ties to the rollback rule.

I'll update the test harness with the sampling plan and alert thresholds and share a link by EOD.

—Marcus
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Anita Shah <anita@mednexus.com>, Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@mednexus.com>
Date: Tue, 17 Nov 2026 16:48:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff — proposed decision canvas + success measures

Team / Anita — read-through looks good. Quick procurement note: the rollback triggers as written are acceptable provided we include a 72-hour remediation window before any contract-level enforcement (we need to avoid automatic termination language). Also request we add a single-sheet evidence package template (we have a DocuSign and compliance checklist requirement for legal).

Actions agreed:
- Camila to share final MAP workbook with sample plan and amended rollback language (due Thu 11/19).
- Marcus to publish updated eval-test-harness.md with sampling and alert thresholds (due Wed 11/18).
- Anita/Tom to confirm the week 2 access window and share the infra contact for data pulls.

If no objections I'll produce the one-pager evidence template and include a DocuSign-ready clause for the remediation window.

Thanks — Lauren
Director, Sales Operations | Redwood Inference
